Anant sinh ki beti shivangi ki shadi ko lekar charchaen tej hain. is bich chhote sarkar ke hone vale samdhi ranvijay sinh bhi anant sinh ke andaj ke murid ho gae hain. ranvijay sinh ne anant sinh ki ek khas ada ki tariph ki hai. aakhir chhote sarkar ki kis bat par phida hain hone vale samdhi? dekhie yah khas riport.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
